entry.title: Sample backdated post
entry.content:
This post is already live because published is in the past. The public date stays 1 March 2024.

Internal links are rewritten from the old path to this site’s base_url:

  • Scheduled sister post (hidden on the public site until due)
  • Import notes page (import with --include-pages)

Google wrapper links are stripped to text only: sample import.

Keep HTML simple

Allowed tags include p, headings h2–h6, lists, blockquote, links, and emphasis. Inline style attributes are removed on import.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: A live post whose publish date is in the past (backdated).

entry.title: Sample scheduled post
entry.content:
This post is scheduled. Editors see it in admin; visitors do not until 15 January 2099 (site timezone).

Related: the backdated sample.

No cron job is required. Each public request checks published_at.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: A published post that stays off the public site until the future datetime.
entry.cms:meta_title: Sample scheduled post: Atom SEO and AEO
entry.cms:llm_summary: This example stays hidden until its scheduled time and demonstrates native CMS SEO and AEO fields in Atom.
entry.cms:citation_snippet: Future-dated LIVE Atom entries are scheduled without a cron job because public requests check published_at.

entry.title: Sample draft post
entry.content: This entry uses blogger:status DRAFT, so it lands in admin as a draft and is not public.

entry.title: Sample import notes
entry.content:
This is a PAGE entry. Default import skips it so designed About/FAQ pages are not overwritten.

To write it as /p/sample-import-notes, run with --include-pages (and --update if the slug already exists).
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Notes page for the Atom import template.
